prompt: What city does the band whose song spent the most weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot Rock & Alternative Songs chart as of August 1, 2024 originate from?
answer: The band is **Panic! at the Disco**, whose “High Hopes” had spent the most weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot Rock & Alternative Songs chart as of August 1, 2024. The band originated in **Las Vegas, Nevada**.
